book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: وصلت مدينة عالبحر وفيها ناس طيبين.
sentences.en: I reached a city on the sea with kind people.

sentences.ar: حكوا لي: عنا شغلة غريبة كل يوم.
sentences.en: They told me: we have a strange business every day.
At sunset, they go out to the boats and sleep in them.
Because the apes come down on the city at night.

sentences.ar: صرت أرمي حجار عالقرود وهي ترمي جوز.
sentences.en: I began throwing stones at the apes and they threw nuts.
I gathered the nuts and sold them and became rich.
And I returned to Baghdad once again.
